top_signals.title: How Closed Airspace Threatens U.S. Military Mobility Across Eurasia
top_signals.summary:
For much of the modern aviation era, geography was something the global aviation industry learned to overcome. Simply put, unlike a railway, a pipeline, or a highway, an aircraft does not require a continuous physical infrastructure between its point of departure and its destination. Routes could change, aircraft could move between markets, and hubs could rise and decline. If economics justified a service, aviation possessed an extraordinary ability to find another way through. top_signals.title: Homin Lee: Equity Markets Can Manage Yield Rise
top_signals.summary: Homin Lee, senior macro strategist at Lombard Odier, says equity valuations can handle the ongoing rise in global yields. He argues higher yields reflect solid economic fundamentals rather than aggressive monetary tightening. (Source: Bloomberg)
